designNotes: 125 deity-specific thematic subclass paths, not 125 new base classes.
Every path has a distinct name, role, theme and three prototype features, but features are shared mechanical scaffolds and must be differentiated through playtesting.
No new spell slots, feats, levels or item rewards are granted by this catalog.
Use standard 2024 class progression as baseline; listed level placements are provisional and need rulebook verification.
No assumption that a deity grants a subclass to a hostile character; story relationship requires adjudication.
Cross-era manifestations and divine incarnation are chronology-gated.
This library is independent of locked 150-item endgame divine treasury.

features.name: Cosmic Edict: Initiation
features.effect: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, invoke dream and cosmological law for 1 minute. Choose one creature within 30 feet: an ally gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus, or an enemy you can see has its speed reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect does not stack with itself.

features.name: Cosmic Edict: Revelation
features.effect: Once per long rest when you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw involving dream and cosmological law, add 1d4 after rolling but before the DM declares success or failure.

features.name: Cosmic Edict: Apotheosis
features.effect: Once per long rest, as an action, create a 10-foot-radius aura for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, choose one creature in the aura: an ally gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus or a hostile creature takes force damage equal to your proficiency bonus (no save). The aura ends if you are incapacitated.

paths.deityRelationship: Character may revere, bargain with, oppose, or inherit a thematic mark; DM decides actual patron/deity access
